findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to `startOfDay(day)` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's documented intent and any code relying on the previous behavior.

summary.problem: The change to `endOfDay` breaks its contract by returning the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The refactor uses `startOfDay` to avoid duplicating date normalization logic.
